name: com.morilab.unidaw
description: Chiptune DAW inside the Unity Editor: step sequencer + tracker hybrid, 4ch (2 pulse / triangle / noise), parameter locks, tracker effects, MIDI file import/export and MIDI input (Windows).

samples.description: Demo songs (feature tour, a lo-fi tune, a 7/8 boss theme), the feature-tour song imported from MIDI, and a scene that plays it with UniDAWPlayer + UniDAWVisualizer.
